props.description: What HeroUI Native hands a toast component: its id, position in the stack, and `hide`.
props.name: toast

props.description: The message the toast shows, as its first line.
props.name: title

props.description: A second line under the message.
props.name: description

props.description: The caller's icon, or `false` for none; left out, the tone's icon is drawn.
props.name: icon

props.description: The person the toast is about, drawn in place of the icon.
props.name: avatar

props.description: The look the provider gives every toast. Defaults to `alert`.
props.name: variant

props.description: The one action beside the message.
props.name: action

props.description: The accessible name of the dismiss button.
props.name: dismissLabel

props.description: The accessible name of every toast's dismiss button in the app's language, for example "Dismiss notification".
props.name: dismissLabel

props.description: The screen edge toasts appear against. Defaults to `bottom`.
props.name: position

props.description: Where along that edge: the inline `start`, the `center`, the inline `end` or `full` width. Defaults to `center`.
props.name: align

props.description: The look of every toast: `alert`, `bar`, `flip-bar` or `bubble`. Defaults to `alert`.
props.name: variant

props.description:
Custom wrapper function to wrap the toast content
Receives children and should return a component that wraps them
The wrapper should apply flex: 1 (via className or style) to ensure proper layout
Can be any component wrapper - KeyboardAvoidingView, View, or any custom component
props.name: contentWrapper

props.description:
When true, uses a regular View instead of FullWindowOverlay on iOS for toasts.
Enables React Native element inspector but toasts won't appear above native modals.
props.name: disableFullWindowOverlay

props.description: Insets for spacing from screen edges (added to safe area insets)
props.name: insets

props.description:
Maximum number of visible toasts before opacity starts fading
Controls when toast items begin to fade out as they move beyond the visible stack
props.name: maxVisibleToasts

props.description:
Controls whether VoiceOver treats the toast overlay window as a modal container.
When `false`, VoiceOver can still access elements behind the overlay.
When `true`, VoiceOver is restricted to elements inside the overlay.
props.name: unstable_accessibilityContainerViewIsModal
